The vocal delivery becomes slightly more emphatic as it reads out the frustrations of the travelers. The electronic synth layers in the BGM stay constant. The narrator poses a question to the audience, maintaining a professional yet engaging pitch contour until the audio fades out abruptly with a final hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Comparative Evidence -> Specific Case Study -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a critical commentary on the high cost of domestic tourism in Taiwan, specifically in Kenting. By juxtaposing expensive local room rates with much more affordable and high-quality international options in places like Bali and Japan, the narrator highlights a significant value gap. It further uses a specific incident involving price gouging during a Twice concert to emphasize consumer grievances, ultimately aiming to provoke discussion and engagement among viewers about their own travel experiences.
